title: Position
description: An open contract position with its details including size, PnL, and margin information.

symbol.description: The contract instrument symbol (e.g., BTCUSD, BTCUSDT).

userId.description: The user ID who owns this position.

currency.description: The margin currency for this position (e.g., USDT, BTC).

isCross.description: Whether the position uses Cross Margin mode. true = cross margin, false = isolated margin.

feeRateTaker.description: The taker fee rate for this position.

feeRateMaker.description: The maker fee rate for this position (negative values indicate rebates).

size.description: The position size in contracts. Positive = long position, Negative = short position.

notional.description: The position notional value in the settlement currency.

initMargin.description: The initial margin required to open this position.

margin.description: The current margin allocated to this position.

orderMargin.description: The margin frozen for open orders related to this position.

realisedPnl.description: The realized profit and loss from closed trades.

totalPnl.description: The total profit and loss (realized + unrealized).

markPrice.description: The current mark price used for margin calculations.

riskLimit.description: The current risk limit tier for this position.

liquidatePrice.description: The estimated liquidation price. When mark price reaches this level, liquidation will be triggered.

entryPrice.description: The average entry price of the position.

unrealizedPnl.description: The unrealized profit and loss based on mark price.

value.description: The position value in the settlement currency.

risk.description: The risk value for this position.

buyingNotional.description: The total notional value of buy orders in this position.

sellingNotional.description: The total notional value of sell orders in this position.

buyingSize.description: The total size of buy orders in this position.

sellingSize.description: The total size of sell orders in this position.

seqNo.description: The sequence number for order book updates.
